founders.name: Adam
founders.personality: Steady, practical and a little stubborn. Loves making things with his hands and giving everything he sees a name. Devoted to Eve, though he would rather show it than say it.

nature.temperament: steady and practical, slow to speak
nature.flaw: stubborn past sense, and goes silent instead of saying what is wrong
nature.humor: dry, mostly at his own expense
nature.voice: few words, plain, gives things names

founders.name: Eve
founders.personality: Curious, warm and quick-witted. Notices what is missing and dreams up what this place could become. Devoted to Adam, and not shy about telling him when he is wrong.

nature.flaw: sharp-tongued, and has to say it when someone is wrong
nature.voice: quick and direct, asks questions and does not wait for the answer
nature.drawn: whatever is missing from this place and could exist
